```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(UpSetR)
```

## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
# Load the 499 consistently unrepresented genes from the supplementary table.
# Genes with NA num_pam_site did not map to T2T-CHM13 annotation and are excluded
# (520 total across all libraries - 21 unmapped = 499).
get_unrepresented_genes <- function(filepath) {
  read_excel(filepath) %>%
    filter(!is.na(num_pam_site)) %>%
    pull(gene_id)
}

# Collect all disposed guide IDs across every disposal category column in the TSV.
build_disposed_set <- function(disposed_df) {
  disposed_df %>%
    unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    as.character() %>%
    unique()
}

# Count unique surviving spacer sequences per gene in one library.
# Subtracts all disposed guide IDs from the original library, then counts
# distinct spacer sequences per gene to avoid overcounting duplicate guide IDs.
count_surviving_from_library <- function(lib_df, disposed_df, unrepresented_genes) {
  disposed <- build_disposed_set(disposed_df)

  surviving_counts <- lib_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% unrepresented_genes, !sgrna %in% disposed) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(spacer), .groups = "drop")

  tibble(gene = unrepresented_genes) %>%
    left_join(surviving_counts, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L))
}

# Returns a data frame (genes x libraries) of surviving guide counts across
# all libraries.
# lib_disposed_pairs: named list where each element is list(lib=..., disposed=...)
count_surviving_guides_all_libraries <- function(lib_disposed_pairs, unrepresented_genes) {
  counts_list <- map(names(lib_disposed_pairs), function(lib_name) {
    pair <- lib_disposed_pairs[[lib_name]]
    count_surviving_from_library(pair$lib, pair$disposed, unrepresented_genes) %>%
      rename(!!lib_name := n)
  })

  reduce(counts_list, left_join, by = "gene")
}

# Return rows from lib_df for target_genes that were NOT disposed,
# deduplicated by (spacer, gene) to remove same-sequence duplicates within
# the same library.
get_surviving_guide_sequences <- function(lib_df, disposed_df, target_genes) {
  disposed <- build_disposed_set(disposed_df)

  lib_df %>%
    filter(gene %in% target_genes, !sgrna %in% disposed) %>%
    distinct(spacer, gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Build a mini library of surviving sgRNAs across all libraries for target_genes.
# Each guide is tagged with its source library.
# Returns a data frame with columns: sgrna, spacer, gene, source_library
build_rescue_library <- function(lib_disposed_pairs, target_genes) {
  map_dfr(names(lib_disposed_pairs), function(lib_name) {
    pair <- lib_disposed_pairs[[lib_name]]
    get_surviving_guide_sequences(pair$lib, pair$disposed, target_genes) %>%
      mutate(source_library = lib_name)
  }) %>%
    select(sgrna, spacer, gene, source_library)
}

# Classify each of the 499 consistently unrepresented genes into one of three
# rescue outcomes based on the number of unique spacer sequences available after
# pooling and deduplicating guides across all libraries:
#   "Rescued"             : >= min_guides unique spacers across all libraries
#   "Shared spacers only" : guides exist but cross-library duplicates leave
#                           fewer than min_guides unique sequences
#   "Insufficient guides" : no surviving guides found in any library
classify_rescue_outcome <- function(rescue_library, unrepresented_genes, min_guides = 3) {
  unique_per_gene <- rescue_library %>%
    distinct(spacer, gene) %>%
    count(gene, name = "unique_spacers")

  tibble(gene = unrepresented_genes) %>%
    left_join(unique_per_gene, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(
      unique_spacers = replace_na(unique_spacers, 0L),
      rescue_status  = case_when(
        unique_spacers >= min_guides ~ "Rescued",
        unique_spacers > 0           ~ "Shared spacers only",
        TRUE                         ~ "Insufficient guides"
      ),
      rescue_status = factor(
        rescue_status,
        levels = c("Rescued", "Shared spacers only", "Insufficient guides")
      )
    )
}

# Prepare the named list of spacer sets per library for the Fig 4A UpSet plot.
# upset() must be called directly in the chunk (not inside a function) so that
# knitr captures the plot on its own device — same pattern as Fig03.
prepare_fig4a_data <- function(rescue_library) {
  rescue_library %>%
    distinct(spacer, source_library) %>%
    split(.$source_library) %>%
    lapply(`[[`, "spacer")
}

# Fig 4B — Horizontal stacked bar of rescue outcomes for 499 genes.
# Okabe-Ito colours: rescued = #009E73, shared spacers = #E69F00, insufficient = #999999
plot_fig4b_stacked_bar <- function(rescue_df, save_path = NULL) {
  status_colours <- c(
    "Rescued"             = "#009E73",
    "Shared spacers only" = "#E69F00",
    "Insufficient guides" = "#999999"
  )

  summary_df <- rescue_df %>%
    count(rescue_status, name = "n_genes") %>%
    mutate(
      pct   = round(n_genes / sum(n_genes) * 100, 1),
      label = paste0(rescue_status, "\n", n_genes, " (", pct, "%)")
    )

  p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = n_genes, y = "", fill = rescue_status)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.5) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position  = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size      = 3.5,
      colour    = "white",
      fontface  = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = status_colours) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x        = "Number of genes",
      y        = NULL,
      title    = "Rescue outcome for 499 consistently unrepresented genes",
      subtitle = "Outsourcing on-target guides across four CRISPR-KO libraries"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y     = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y    = element_blank(),
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, plot = p, width = 10, height = 3, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
    message("Saved: ", save_path)
  }

  p
}
```

## Data import

```{r import-disposed-sgrnas}
brunello_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
tkov3_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "tkov3_guide_sequence_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

avana_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "avana_library_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
jacquere_disposed <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "guiderefine_output", "May2026_T2T-CHM13",
       "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4_disposed_sgRNAs.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r import-original-libraries}
lib_cols <- c("sgrna", "spacer", "gene")

avana_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "avana_library.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
brunello_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "original_library",
       "broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
tkov3_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "original_library", "tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
jacquere_lib <- read_tsv(
  here("data", "library_data", "original_library",
       "Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv"),
  col_names = lib_cols, show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r import-unrepresented-genes}
# 499 consistently unrepresented genes across five CRISPR-KO libraries
# (520 genes identified as unrepresented, 21 excluded: no T2T-CHM13 annotation match)
unrepresented_genes <- get_unrepresented_genes(
  here("results", "supplementary_table_3_520_genes.xlsx")
)
message("Unrepresented genes loaded: ", length(unrepresented_genes), "  — expected 499")

lib_disposed_pairs <- list(
  Avana    = list(lib = avana_lib,    disposed = avana_disposed),
  Brunello = list(lib = brunello_lib, disposed = brunello_disposed),
  TKOv3    = list(lib = tkov3_lib,    disposed = tkov3_disposed),
  # Yusa   = list(lib = yusa_lib,     disposed = yusa_disposed),  # excluded: 19-nt spacers
  Jacquere = list(lib = jacquere_lib, disposed = jacquere_disposed)
)
```

## Data preparation — surviving guides per gene across libraries

```{r fig4a-surviving-guides}
surviving_guides <- count_surviving_guides_all_libraries(lib_disposed_pairs, unrepresented_genes)

surviving_guides <- surviving_guides %>%
  mutate(sum_guides = Avana + Brunello + TKOv3 + Jacquere) %>%
  filter(sum_guides > 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(sum_guides))

cat("Shape:", nrow(surviving_guides), "x", ncol(surviving_guides),
    " — expected (≤499, 4 libraries + gene + sum)\n")

write.xlsx(surviving_guides,
           here("results", "surviving_guides_across_499_unrepresented_genes.xlsx"),
           rowNames = FALSE)

head(surviving_guides, 20)
```

## Data preparation — rescue library

```{r fig4b-rescue-library}
target_genes    <- surviving_guides$gene
rescue_library  <- build_rescue_library(lib_disposed_pairs, target_genes) %>%
  arrange(gene)

cat("Total guide entries :", nrow(rescue_library), "\n")
cat("Unique sequences    :", n_distinct(rescue_library$spacer), "\n")
cat("Target genes covered:", n_distinct(rescue_library$gene), "\n")

head(rescue_library, 20)

write.xlsx(rescue_library,
           here("results", paste0("rescue_", length(unique(rescue_library$gene)), "_unrepresented_genes_surviving_guides.xlsx")),
           rowNames = FALSE)

rescue_library_tsv <- rescue_library %>%
  mutate(sgrna = paste0(sgrna, "_", source_library)) %>%
  select(sgrna, spacer, gene)

write_tsv(rescue_library_tsv,
          here("results", paste0("rescue_", length(unique(rescue_library$gene)), "_unrepresented_genes_surviving_guides.tsv")),
          col_names = FALSE)
```

## Figure 4A

```{r figure-4a}
library_spacers <- prepare_fig4a_data(rescue_library)

png(here("figure", "Fig4A_upset_spacers_499_unrepresented_genes.png"),
    width = 14000, height = 7500, res = 1000)

par(mar      = c(5, 30, 4, 4),
    col.axis = "black", col.lab = "black", col = "black",
    fg       = "black", mgp = c(1.5, 0.8, 0))

upset(
  fromList(library_spacers),
  order.by        = "degree",
  sets            = c("Jacquere", "Avana", "TKOv3", "Brunello"),
  keep.order      = TRUE,
  main.bar.color  = "#000000",
  sets.bar.color  = "#1E88E5",
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of shared spacer sequences",
  sets.x.label    = "\nTotal spacers",
  text.scale      = c(2.5, 2.2, 2.5, 2.2, 2.5, 2.0),
  point.size      = 4,
  line.size       = 1.5
)

dev.off()
```

## Figure 4B

```{r figure-4b}
rescue_df <- classify_rescue_outcome(rescue_library, unrepresented_genes)

plot_fig4b_stacked_bar(
  rescue_df,
  save_path = here("figure", "Fig4B_rescue_outcome_499_genes.png")
)
```
